name: @withinfocus/statbotics-mcp-server
description: Statistics and predictions for FIRST Robotics Competition from the Statbotics API: EPA ratings, season, team, event and match data, and win probabilities, with 12 read-only tools. Also serves four analytics skills over MCP for sizing up an event, checking match odds, tracking a team through a season and setting season benchmarks.

STATBOTICS_API_KEY.description: Optional Statbotics API key (get one at https://www.statbotics.io/apikey)

STATBOTICS_MCP_SKILLS.description: Set to off, false or 0 to stop serving the analytics skills

tools.name: get_year
tools.description: Look up Statbotics season summary statistics for a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) year.

tools.name: get_years
tools.description: List Statbotics season summary statistics across multiple FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) years in a single call.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Look up the Statbotics profile for a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) team by team number.

tools.name: get_teams
tools.description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) teams from the Statbotics database with optional filters.

tools.name: get_team_year
tools.description: Get one team's performance summary for one specific FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) season.

tools.name: get_team_years
tools.description: List per-season FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) team statistics with flexible filters - useful for cross-team or cross-year analysis.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Look up a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) event by its event key.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) events with optional filters - the discovery tool for finding event keys and browsing the season schedule.

tools.name: get_team_event
tools.description: Get one team's performance at one specific FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) event.

tools.name: get_team_events
tools.description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) team-event records with flexible filters.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Look up a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) match by its match key.

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) matches with optional filters.

skills.name: event-favorites
skills.description: Ranks the teams at an event by EPA carried in from earlier events, with auto, teleop and endgame breakdowns and tiers.

skills.name: match-odds
skills.description: Statbotics win probability and predicted score for one match, and where the match is likely won or lost by phase.

skills.name: season-benchmarks
skills.description: Targets from season EPA percentiles and real events, and cross-season comparisons with normalized EPA.

skills.name: team-season-report
skills.description: One team's EPA event by event, its world, country, state and district ranks, and its strongest and weakest phases.
